ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-distal portions of both lobes. These regions are bisected by a low-intensity black band at the median notch. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips, with significant black mottling encroaching into the white regions near the peduncle and notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.5 within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits four distinct, high-amplitude irregular valleys (notches). Right lobe exhibits more frequent, lower-amplitude micro-serrations with three prominent peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the leading margins, terminating in sharp, recurved hooks at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular spots (3-6 pixels each) are visible at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe and scattered along the upper margin of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are mapped across the high-intensity white field of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch.
